description: A256KW on an oct key with alg A128KW and an oct key without alg returns the key without alg; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): member 0's alg A128KW is not A256KW, so it is out, and member 1 has none; both are oct (§2.1), neither has use (U = enc) or key_ops, and selection checks no key size (§2, not part of selection); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
